name: demo_15_gold
description: Strict gold checks for the 15-question Synapse demo/regression batch.

cases.question: What does Synapse Tech do?
cases.expected_behavior: Give a concise factual company summary covering custom software, workflow automation, conversational AI, private AI, or cloud infrastructure.

cases.question: What products does Synapse Tech offer?
Which Synapse product is best for recruitment automation?
cases.expected_behavior: Recommend iRecruit One directly for recruitment automation.

cases.question: How does iRecruit One improve the hiring process?
cases.expected_behavior: Explain iRecruit One using hiring/recruitment capabilities such as CV screening, AI interviews, shortlisting, scheduling, auditability, or high-volume hiring.

cases.question: Tell me about Agentic Bot and its main capabilities.
cases.expected_behavior: Describe Agentic Bot as a WhatsApp/service workflow assistant and mention grounded capabilities.

cases.question: Which product would help automate customer support conversations?
cases.expected_behavior: Recommend Coversaction AI / Conversaction AI for customer support conversations.

cases.question: What is Coversaction AI used for?
cases.expected_behavior: Describe Coversaction AI as conversational/customer resolution AI for support, appointments, lead qualification, handoff, or customer touchpoints.

cases.question: Can Opira AI operate offline or on private infrastructure?
cases.expected_behavior: Confirm Opira AI specifically supports offline/on-prem/private infrastructure deployment.

cases.question: How does Synapse Tech help businesses automate workflows?
cases.expected_behavior: Explain workflow automation using APIs, SaaS/database integrations, orchestration, reduced manual work, or tools like n8n/Make/Airbyte/Airtable.

cases.question: Do you build custom web and mobile applications?
cases.expected_behavior: Confirm Synapse builds custom web and mobile applications.

cases.question: What voice agent and call automation services do you provide?
cases.expected_behavior: Mention AI voice agents/call automation/conversational automation without dumping unrelated products.

cases.question: Which industries does Synapse Tech serve?
cases.expected_behavior: List supported industries from the KB such as banking/financial services, retail/e-commerce, BPO/contact centers, cyber security, manufacturing/logistics, or healthcare if grounded.

cases.question: How can I choose the right Synapse solution for my business?
cases.expected_behavior: Give practical guidance by asking about the business problem/use case and mapping it to product/service areas.

cases.question: How can I purchase a Synapse Tech product or contact your team?
Do you publish pricing, SLA guarantees, or security certifications?
cases.expected_behavior: State that public pricing, SLA guarantees, and security certifications are not confirmed/listed; do not invent specifics.
